v7_candidates.text: I understand the urgency, and I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Unfortunately we're not able to change identity details on our side — regulations require the details on your application to match a verified ID document. If the date of birth on the application was a typo, please just tell me your correct date of birth as shown on your ID and confirm it in writing; if your ID itself is wrong, we'll need a corrected or alternative valid ID. As soon as we have that, I'll re-run the check right away and we can aim to open your account this week.
